ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

Event.description: Event name to match, e.g. $pageview, $autocapture or a custom event.

Selector.description: CSS selector of the target element, e.g. div > button.cta.

TagName.description: HTML tag name to match, e.g. button.

TextMatching.description: How to match the value. `exact`, `contains` or `regex`.

HrefMatching.description: How to match the value. `exact`, `contains` or `regex`.

UrlMatching.description: How to match the value. `exact`, `contains` or `regex`.

Properties.description: Event or person property filters as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. [{"key": "plan", "value": "pro", "operator": "exact", "type": "person"}].
